pages.text: Winter nights were long and long. A new bed for Nils stood in the loft.
Tonight Nils wanted to sleep there alone. "I'm grown up now!" Grandpa wished him good night and took the lamp downstairs.
Nils pulled the covers to his neck. The loft was quiet and dark.
Crack! Wood groaned somewhere. Nils slipped beneath the covers.
Whooo. The window rattled. He shut his eyes tight.
Thump! A heavy sound from the roof. Nils sat straight up.
It was late, but he was wide awake. Every sound chased sleep far away.
Grandpa came up with the lamp. "Night sounds all have names. Crack is wood, whooo is wind, thump is snow sliding off the roof."
Another thump. Nils looked outside. A roof snowball dropped into the yard.
Grandpa took the lamp downstairs. Crack, whooo, thump. Naming each sound one by one, Nils drifted to sleep.
